title: Shedeur Sanders has 'come a long way' in development, Browns coach says

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Browns HC praises Sanders: 'Come a long way'
sources.description: Browns coach Todd Monken praised quarterback Shedeur Sanders' development Wednesday, saying the second-year player has "come a long way."
